UI_RULES: A node is a manifest and one function. It has no markup, styles, colors, fonts, icons or sizes of its own.
The board draws the card, the field, the settings and the result, the same way for every node.
A node asks for at most one text field and three settings, each with two to five choices.
The result is shown as text, a table or a document. The node only returns the data.
The sticker comes from the board's own set.
Labels are plain sentence-case text. No markup.
The function only works with what flows in. It cannot reach the page, the network or storage.
MCP_TOOLS: Returns the manifest format: every key, its limits and the wire types.
Returns the rules that keep nodes looking the same: what the board draws, and what a node may not bring.
Returns the sticker names a node can choose from.
Checks a manifest and returns every problem with the key it is on.
Runs the node on sample input and returns what the board would show.
Uploads a manifest that passes validate_node to the market, under your account.
BOARD_TOOLS: Reads what is on the board and what is selected.
Draws a box, a decision, or a start or end shape, with its text.
Draws an arrow from one thing to another.
